{{Season|All}} (Fable Reef) |Sell Price = {{Price|80}} |dsvprice = 80 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Forage|forageable]] item that can be obtained by foraging at [[Stardew:The Beach|The Beach]] or [[Fable Reef]]. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Gifting== Sand Dollar is a '''universally neutral''' gift, with the following exceptions. {{Gifting |love= Vincent |like= Elliott,Evelyn,Gunther,Jas,Sandy,Willy |hate= Harvey }} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|white}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces an white color. {{PAGENAME}} can be used in the spool of the [[Stardew:2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Stardew:Tailoring|Strapped Top]]. ==History== {{Navbox Forage}} [[Category:Forage]][[Category:Items]] [[zh:沙钱]]
